name: Microgrid resource heartbeat supervisor
aliases: microgrids Microgrid supervisory and communication interfaces
summary: Monitors the declared periodic health indication of the assigned resource controller.
description: Monitors the declared periodic health indication of the assigned resource controller. Microgrid supervision coordinates measurements, control authority and resource communication without replacing local protection. Each resource value needs a named measurement boundary, freshness condition and intended control use.

In a microgrid control room, the operator can see source availability, active constraints and current operating mode. A communication failure should remain distinguishable from an electrical resource failure. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Resource heartbeat and time” at the input and “Controller communication-health state” at the output. A heartbeat does not establish electrical availability.
